stem: Which sentence can **BEST** follow and support sentence 20?

options.label: A
options.text: There are other ecosystem engineers on the planet that scientists are studying and learning more about.

options.label: B
options.text: This name, ecosystem engineer, was given to these burrow-digging, egg-laying species based on what they do.

options.label: C
options.text: An ecosystem engineer makes changes to the environment from which other species can also benefit.

options.label: D
options.text: When a community of organisms interact with the environment together, it is an ecosystem.

visual_elements: Question with four multiple choice answer boxes labeled A, B, C, D
